title: Running Between The Wickets (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, more batters get out running between the wickets
than get bowled out
COMMUNICATION IS EVERYTHING

[Verse 1]
Bat slides down the ground, eye on the fielders throw
Before you leave the crease, look and go
Loud clear call, YES NO WAIT
One word, one voice, one decisive fate

Runner calls if the ball goes to their side
Non-striker calls when it goes the other wide
Dive when in doubt, bat over the line
Communication and ground judgment, that is fine

[Pre-Chorus]
Yes or no, call it clear
Bat over line, nothing to fear
Ground your bat, dive when tight
Running the twos, that is done right

[Chorus]
Running between wickets, call it loud
Yes no wait, no room for doubt
Bat grounded over the crease in time
Running between wickets, singles are mine

[Verse 2]
The quick single worth three boundaries
If you run them well and call them all
Straight hard lines between the wickets run
Ground the bat and turn, the extra run is won

[Bridge]
Bluey: They are running a brilliant two here, quick between the wickets
Trevor: Communication, timing, and ground judgment, all three present simultaneously
Chas: Trevor, I drilled YES NO calls for two years before I let him bat in a match

[Chorus]
Running between wickets, call it loud
Yes no wait, no room for doubt
Bat grounded over the crease in time
Running between wickets, singles are mine

[Outro]
Call it early son
Yes, NO, WAIT
Thats my boy
